'''Dorin''' was a dark and dusty [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dors]], with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Dorin gas/Legends|unique gas]] and [[Helium/Legends|helium]].

==Description==
[[File:Kel_Dor_Sniper.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]]]]
Dorin was situated between two [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]], making access to the planet limited; any space travel for the natives was also highly dangerous,<ref name="SECR" /> as Dorin's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] contained very little [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], and barely supported life (although some flora did exist on the planet). The inhabitants had evolved to survive in an environment within which most other species would perish, being effectively void of oxygen, [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]]. This atmospheric composition affected the travel capabilities of the native [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], requiring them to wear [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath masks]] to filter out oxygen while off-world. Likewise, most off-worlders and non-Kel Dor species visiting Dorin would have to wear [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] of their own for the gases they required. [[Human/Legends|Humans]], however, could survive at least a short time in the atmosphere without suffering any ill effects; the exact length of time possible has not been measured.

Kel Dor society and industry largely revolved around technology. Although most Kel Dor were regarded as highly altruistic to the welfare of other beings, their justice system was strict, and swift, on potential criminals and lawbreakers.<ref name="SECR" />

Dorin's weather was very powerful, tumultuous, and quite unpredictable. Buildings on the planet's surface were constructed specifically to withstand violent storms and, in times of severe weather, most locations and homes were made available for anyone (Kel Dor or otherwise) to take shelter in. The [[Baran Do]] used their gifts in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to predict harsh weather phenomena, supplemented by satellites and other technology in the modern day.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], his [[Plo Koon's uncle|uncle]], and his [[Koon family|niece]], [[Sha Koon]], were all from Dorin.

==History==
The planet was home of the [[Baran Do]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] group predating the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> Dorin joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[5975 BBY]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> and had direct representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. As so many Jedi came from Dorin, the Republic funded the construction of an [[Jedi Enclave (Dorin)|enclave]] on the planet. The atmospheric conditions limited most of the regular students to the native Kel Dor, although many Jedi of other species utilized a breathing mask to visit and to learn from the Kel Dor masters. While its isolation allowed the planet to remain unharmed by the [[Old Sith Wars]], nearly all Jedi at the enclave on Dorin were killed by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] following the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> During the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Dorin (New Sith Wars)|battle]] won by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dorin was a staunch supporter of the Galactic Republic. It backed the formation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], contributing a small number of defense troops and ships to the war effort.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the conflict, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led an [[Battle of Dorin|attack]] on Dorin, but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defeated his [[Battle droid/Legends|forces]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], Dorin nominally fell under the authority of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sticrie]], who governed the sector from [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]]. However, he largely avoided involvement in Kel Dor affairs unless there was a disruption in tax collection.<ref name="Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Dorin was located within space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] of [[7 ABY/Legends|7]]&ndash;[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and was within the core territory of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Dorin was outside of Imperial space by the [[10 ABY/Legends|following year]], during which time it was [[Battle of Dorin (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] by Imperial forces, as part of an offensive by the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Empire|alliance]] of Imperial factions.<ref name="TEA" /> Dorin later joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="TEGtW-" /> and the Baran Do engaged in contact and exchange with the [[New Jedi Order]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet fell into the hands of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders. After [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the territory of the Imperial Remnant expanded, and Dorin would be within the borders of the Remnant during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] of [[40 ABY/Legends|40]]&ndash;[[41 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] traveled to Dorin to consult the Baran Do and their involvement in [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Outcast" />

Early in the reign of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], Dorin was blockaded by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The [[One Sith|Sith]] then ordered that the best and brightest of the Kel Dor must offer their service to the Empire, or their people would suffer. As a result, many Kel Dor entered the Imperial service, though the blockade remained in place. Thus, a secret route onto the world (called the [[Dorin Run]]) was discovered by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]; however, the passage lay so close to the black holes that all but the most reckless travelers considered it far too dangerous to utilize.<ref name="LECG" />
